title: Video From Workspace
text: Import video from MATLAB workspace, 4 outputs, {Signal} sets Video to read; {Sample time} sets the sample period of the output video, {Form output after final value by} sets the form of block output after final video frame Setting, {Image signal} sets the output mode of video signal One multidimensional and {Output port labels} sets the output port names R. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: Output image or video M -by- N -by- T array | M -by- N -by- C -by- T array

ports.name: R
ports.summary: Red color component of input video 3-D array

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Green color component of input video 3-D array

ports.name: B
ports.summary: Blue color component of input video 3-D array

params.name: Signal
params.values: Video to read rand(32,32,3,5) (default) | M -by- N -by- T array | M -by- N -by- C -by- T array | MATLAB workspace variable

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample period of the output video 1 (default) | -1 | positive scalar

params.name: Form output after final value by
params.values: Form of block output after final video frame Setting to zero (default) | Holding final value | Cyclic repetition

params.name: Image signal
params.values: Output mode of video signal One multidimensional signal (default) | Separate color signals

params.name: Output port labels
params.values: Output port names R|G|B (default) | text labels separated by vertical bars
